visual_review.method: Direct visual inspection of all baseline pages; final pages 1-7 are pixel-identical to that inspected baseline. Final main spreads 4-6 (pages 7-12) and final assessment pages 1-3 directly inspected.
visual_review.findings: No unresolved clipping, overlap, missing glyph or illegible layout detected. Proof and reference flow inspected.
visual_review.limits: Author visual inspection, not an independent reader study or mathematical proof.
